scope: native-world include repair and porting-gap assessment: the openrbx-derived port now resolves its own headers and the SimJob type, and its two remaining semantic gaps are precisely identified with 2008-06 evidence.

repairs_applied.evidence: the port's sources #include "v8world/Assembly.h" etc. and its own include tree (native-world/App/include/v8world) is on no default /I path; before the line the donor tools/rbxgs/.../v8world/Assembly.h was resolved instead (error C2653 'SleepInfo' is not a class). The /I{headers} placeholder expansion was verified in the compile receipt (an initial three-dot variant was corrected to one dot).

the port references RBX::SimJob (getJob/setJob/job) without any declaration - the port's own tree has no SimJob.h and tools/openrbx has only SimJobStage.h. The 2008-06 binary does have RBX::SimJob (functions at 005e5190/005e51e0/005e5200) and the recovered header App/include/v8world/SimJob2008.h declares the real class (RTTI 0083f72c, ctor 005e50f0) under the engine headers' "2008" filename suffix. After the include the SimJob errors are gone.

remaining_porting_gaps.gap: Assembly.h(110): void setMechanism(Mechanism* value) { job = value; } and setJob(SimJob*) share one SimJob* job member
remaining_porting_gaps.evidence: 2008-06: Mechanism stores its job at Mechanism+0x0 ('Mechanism (005e5350 ...) pushes `this` into simJob+0x4 and stores the job at its +0x0' per the SimJob2008.h header) and SimJob holds std::vector<Mechanism*> mechanisms at +0x4 - i.e. Mechanism does NOT derive from SimJob in 2008-06. The port's implicit Mechanism->SimJob conversion is the later-source inheritance.
remaining_porting_gaps.owner_decision: either adapt the port to the 2008 relationship (a Mechanism accessor that reads Mechanism+0x0), or map the port's job member to the 2008 Mechanism-owns-SimJob shape.

remaining_porting_gaps.gap: ClumpStage.cpp(46): RBX::Primitive::getSizeMultiplier is not a member
remaining_porting_gaps.evidence: the port calls a later-version Primitive member; the 2008-06 Primitive layout (recovered Primitive2008.h chain) has no such member.
remaining_porting_gaps.owner_decision: implement against the 2008 Primitive fields or park the call site.

verification: All six units now fail with exactly these two gaps (they previously failed on the unresolved SimJob/headers); no further distinct missing identifiers were found in the compile logs.
status: include repairs applied and captured in draft sessions; the port remains blocked on two owner-level semantic decisions
next: Owner: resolve the Mechanism/SimJob relationship question (the 2008-06 RTTI/vtable evidence is already recorded in SimJob2008.h), then the Primitive::getSizeMultiplier mapping; after those two decisions the port should compile and its functions can be diffed against 2008-06 for the first real parity batch.
